sourceDecision: Retain production. Paths search exactly logical path/namespace/Secret name, then project original id/path/namespace/name plus fields.length/retention. Mounts search name and individual namespace members before joining namespaces for display, then project original id/name/joined namespaces/revision. Both lowercase text/query and use includes without trimming or locale/accent/token normalization. IDs/revisions/retention/mapping field/key are not search operands. Projections precede separately reviewed shared table sorting/slicing. Saved uppercase/absent search assertions do not isolate every field or qualify mounted filtering. No concrete supported correction compatible with frozen expectations established.
